headline: Global Market & Macro Context
flowing_prose: Global market risk sentiment was shaped by fresh overseas geopolitical developments, notably Iran's rhetoric warning of retaliation without limitations, evolving US policy signals, and maritime transit monitoring across the Strait of Hormuz, elevating headline sensitivity across trade routes. Crude oil benchmarks held steady with Brent crude hovering near benchmark levels, as energy participants weighed physical supply security against broader macroeconomic consumption trends. Benchmark sovereign bond yields stabilized as institutional participants assessed global monetary policy guidance. Asian equities opened predominantly in positive territory following supportive cues from Wall Street, while GIFT Nifty pointed toward a steady to positive opening for domestic bourses. Three Things to Watch: 1) Retaliatory risks and diplomatic friction in the Middle East; 2) Domestic fuel marketing margins and upstream realisations as crude benchmarks digest supply news; 3) Institutional FPI flows and GIFT Nifty opening trajectory.
